recommendedPatchOrder.label: Confirm first real static map import file

recommendedPatchOrder.reason: CSS-only selector files cannot reduce JS vendor-map weight.

recommendedPatchOrder.label: Avoid archive and CSS files
recommendedPatchOrder.action: Do not touch _archive files or CSS selectors in the first map isolation patch.
recommendedPatchOrder.reason: Archive and CSS changes can create noise without reducing the JS map chunk.

recommendedPatchOrder.label: Patch one map boundary only
recommendedPatchOrder.action: Convert one static map library import to dynamic import or wrap one map component with React.lazy.
recommendedPatchOrder.reason: One patch at a time keeps route behavior easy to verify.

recommendedPatchOrder.label: Build and compare bundle inventory
recommendedPatchOrder.action: Run npm build and regenerate inventory after the first map patch.
recommendedPatchOrder.reason: We need measured proof that vendor-map or pages chunk moved in the right direction.

recommendedPatchOrder.label: Then decide next map split
recommendedPatchOrder.action: Only continue if build passes and route/browser signoff still looks good.
